title: Coherent tensor-restriction systems on a tower of algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $Y_n$, $n\geq0$, be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], with morphisms $j_n:Y_n\to Y_{n+1}$. A module on $Y_n$ is coherent if it is quasi-coherent [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module] and its restriction to every etale scheme chart [def-trf-space-module-scheme-restriction] is coherent in the sense of [pqf-def-coherent]. Define the category of coherent tensor-restriction systems to have objects coherent modules $F_n$ on $Y_n$ and specified isomorphisms $\varphi_n:j_n^*F_{n+1}\simeq F_n$, using the tensor pullbacks of [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. An arrow from $(F_n,\varphi_n)$ to $(G_n,\psi_n)$ is a family $a_n:F_n\to G_n$ satisfying $\psi_n\circ j_n^*(a_{n+1})=a_n\circ\varphi_n$ for every $n$. Identities and composition are componentwise; these operations obey the category laws. Evaluation at $n$ takes the actual component module and component map. In the infinitesimal-thickening application, index $n$ represents the positive level $n+1$.
